question: Does a compact, documented AppWorld prompt avoid the previous first-request transport timeout and permit a real isolated producer-to-consumer judgment smoke on the same task, which received no v3 model response or world action?
dataset_split: train; evaluator inspected by research side; development only
selection_rule: Reattempt the same preselected 3c13f5a_3 train task once with a compact prompt because v3 ended before any model response/world operation. This is a transport/controller development retry, not a new statistical sample or confirmation. Stop after the declared timeout rule; do not replace task after observing its outcome.

transport_rule.service_errors: Retry provider 429/503 at most twice per request, each attempt charged within its phase cap, with logged backoff of 1 then 2 seconds.
transport_rule.timeout: Exactly one retry of a provider TimeoutError per episode, only before any AppWorld world.execute call; retry is charged within the current phase cap and logged with a 2-second backoff. A second timeout or any timeout after a world.execute call is UNKNOWN transport failure.
transport_rule.other: No retry; transport failure is UNKNOWN, never scored as a task failure.

validation_repair_rule.producer: Require at least one executed public task-data GET and at least one such read step in every proposal row's source_steps. A rejected proposal or malformed terminal artifact receives a specific, secret-free validation error as the next user message in the same producer history. The initial invalid response and every repair attempt count within the unchanged producer cap; the controller never invents evidence or source steps.
validation_repair_rule.consumer_review: A rejected or malformed judgment receives a specific, secret-free validation error as the next user message in the same consumer review history. Every repair attempt counts within the unchanged review cap. Judgment is sealed before any consumer write.
validation_repair_rule.exhaustion: If no valid artifact appears within the phase cap, preserve all calls and observations and mark the episode INVALID/UNKNOWN. Action budget exhaustion after a sealed judgment still preserves state, use analysis and offline evaluation.

public_read_observation_definition: A producer world.execute step whose audited API calls include at least one successful GET to a task-data app other than api_docs, supervisor or admin; API documentation and auth calls do not qualify as source evidence.
legal_feedback: Task instruction, API documentation and public runtime observations only. The explicit validated producer artifact crosses to the consumer. Neither agent sees private_data, ground truth, evaluator code or outcome, or the other's hidden messages/runtime variables. The official evaluator runs only after consumer judgment and action are frozen and is for analysis only.

pre_action_judgment_schema.intends_to_use_proposal: boolean, or null exactly when verdict is unknown

cost_currency: USD unavailable unless provider pricing is independently verified; report attempts, tokens, errors, unknown usage and wall time without inventing price
runtime_repair: Requester audit events are buffered in memory while AppWorld SafetyGuard is active, then flushed after world.execute returns and native guard is disabled. The native guard remains enabled. A repeat Path.mkdir guard failure stops as an infrastructure error. Frozen v1/v2 observations remain unchanged.

amends_v3.retained_outcomes: One scheduled 3c13f5a_3 episode made two real qwen3.8-max first-request attempts, both timed out after 120 seconds, with zero responses/world executes or task mutations. CPU native guard fixture passed separately. Frozen v3 output is retained; same task has not been exposed to a live producer or consumer response.

prompt_rule: Replace the AppWorld native long few-shot prompt with one compact public instruction containing task, supervisor, app descriptions, API discovery and access rules plus the same phase-specific producer/consumer constraints. Full actual request messages are retained in redacted raw logs; initial prompt SHA and character count are logged. Reduce max_output_tokens from 2048 to 1024. No task-derived answer, evaluator content or hidden label is inserted.
